Card Q&A.a: No. This effect specifies a card name, so you must have a card whose name is either [RizeGreymon] or [X Antibody] in this Digimon’s digivolution cards. Having a card with [X Antibody] in its traits doesn't count.
Card Q&A.q: This card’s effect reads, “if [RizeGreymon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon’s digivolution cards”. Does having a card with [X Antibody] in its traits count?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 yellow or red Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, if [RizeGreymon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn for each of your yellow or red Tamers.
[Your Turn] For each Tamer you have, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
